comment: Registers firmware image tables. True entry at push_s blink, push_s r13; 0x9038c is an internal call to RegisterImageTable.
Initializes preview/capture ISP tables. Prologue allocates 204 stack bytes; 0xf26f8 is an internal block constructing capture table pointers. True entry independently decoded at 0xf2664.
Capture-message handler. True entry saves blink/registers at 0x1206d0; internal site 0x1206f4 compares message code 0x401.

Glyph shadow/outline rendering block within the glyph renderer at 0x67f10, not a separate DrawText function. 0x67f10 has its own prologue; DecodeAndBlitImage at 0x67e04 is a separate preceding function.
